result.reason: The clause does not reach the preferred position because it permits the Vendor to assign without consent to an affiliate or successor, including potentially a Customer competitor. It also exceeds the fallback, which permits consent-free assignment only to successors, not affiliates. Granting the Vendor this additional affiliate-assignment right and adding a repricing prohibition go beyond what is needed. Although the language is generally clear and professionally drafted, the margin comment understates the substantive expansion of the Vendor's assignment rights.
